summary: Spec-drift checks are valuable when they produce located, typed differences and treat ambiguity as a review queue, not when they collapse unlike artifacts into an unexplained score.

points.text: Reflexion models establish a durable mechanism: map implementation facts to intended elements, then report convergence, divergence and absence rather than asking whether prose and code are merely similar.
Executable contracts and architecture rules provide high-confidence drift findings; semantic comparison of roadmap or rationale prose should carry lower confidence and require human confirmation.
Every finding should identify both artifact versions, trace link, relevant code or contract location and proposed authority direction so teams know whether code or specification should change.
A scalar drift score hides whether the issue is obsolete documentation, missing implementation, unrecorded design evolution or a broken API; typed counts and trends are more actionable.
